svg.title: The four-phase agent loop
svg.desc: The agent loop runs perceive, think, act, and remember in sequence and returns to perceive until the task is complete or a stop condition ends the run. Think passes a tool call to act, and act passes the tool result to remember. Infinite loops start in act; context exhaustion and lost tool results start in remember.

text.tspan: Pick a tool and its arguments

g.text: NEXT ITERATION UNTIL A STOP CONDITION
